body_es: El Manifiesto Ágil, publicado en 2001, establece cuatro valores fundamentales que priorizan individuos y interacciones sobre procesos y herramientas, software funcionando sobre documentación exhaustiva, colaboración con el cliente sobre negociación de contratos, y respuesta al cambio sobre seguir un plan. Los doce principios que lo acompañan enfatizan la entrega continua de valor, la aceptación de cambios incluso en fases avanzadas, y la cooperación estrecha entre desarrolladores y clientes. Estos principios transforman la forma en que los equipos abordan el desarrollo de software, permitiendo mayor flexibilidad y adaptación a las necesidades reales del negocio.
body_en: The Agile Manifesto, published in 2001, establishes four core values that prioritize individuals and interactions over processes and tools, working software over comprehensive documentation, customer collaboration over contract negotiation, and responding to change over following a plan. The twelve accompanying principles emphasize continuous value delivery, embracing change even in late phases, and close cooperation between developers and customers. These principles transform how teams approach software development, enabling greater flexibility and adaptation to real business needs.
example_code:
# Agile Manifesto Values (YAML representation)
values:
  value_1:
    priority: "Individuals and Interactions"
    over: "Processes and Tools"
  value_2:
    priority: "Working Software"
    over: "Comprehensive Documentation"
  value_3:
    priority: "Customer Collaboration"
    over: "Contract Negotiation"
  value_4:
    priority: "Responding to Change"
    over: "Following a Plan"

principles_count: 12
focus_areas:
  - Early and continuous delivery of valuable software
  - Welcome changing requirements
  - Frequent delivery of working software
  - Close daily cooperation
example_output:
Agile Framework established with:
✓ 4 core values prioritized
✓ 12 guiding principles active
✓ Focus on iterative delivery
✓ Emphasis on stakeholder collaboration
